description: FORMAT DOCUMENTATION ONLY - every value below is INVENTED. These are not real enemies, not real FSM state names, and not discovered data. The ids are deliberately impossible so this file can never match a real enemy if it is accidentally deployed. Copy the SHAPE, never the contents.

Control/Lunge.note: Reflection saw the velocity actions and called it movement only. The hitbox is on a child that is already active, so there was no ActivateGameObject for the classifier to find.

Control/Flinch.note: A hit reaction, not a behaviour. It classified as Displaced movement and cluttered the profile.

Control/Slash Antic.note: Named 'Antic' so the classifier tagged it, but it leads to two states so the auto-link would not commit.

Control/Needle Volley.note: Only reachable via a global event another FSM broadcasts, so no transition points at it and Override could not find a way in.

Arena Hazards/Control/Floor Spikes.note: Lives on a child object. The key is path/FsmName/StateName.

var:Control/Attack Cooldown.note: Below ~0.2 the animations overlap and the boss reads as glitched.
